node.title: Re^5: Perl try { } catch(e) { }
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
There is a full implementation of try-catch block using perl filters

Source filters are unfortunately quite dangerous, they are very prone to making code extremely brittle (Update: for example, [mod://Switch] was removed from the Perl core for that reason, see e.g. [id://1168641]). Note that there is currently development underway to add try/catch to Perl natively - see [https://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2021/01/msg258856.html|Adding a try/catch syntax to Perl] and [https://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2021/02/msg258979.html|Progress on try/catch].
